description: Shell script for testing combined and merge diff handling of binary files and text conversion in Git, including setup of binary and text attributes, and verification of diff outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
